agent_notes: Per the reviewer's request, 15:1-6 is placed in the night (vision at 22:00, stars after) and 15:7ff in the next day's daylight, with the sleep at that day's sunset. The successors (15:7-12) are LOCKED and anchor on the END of this event with no delay, so rather than touch them I gave this event a duration of 8 hours that ends near dawn; the real content is brief, the duration stands for the rest of the night. The alternative reading is one afternoon with 15:5 as seen within the vision (15:1 'in the vision', Rashi/Midrash); I rejected it since the stars need night and the text of 15:12 and 15:17 stresses the later sunset. 'That day' (15:18) is then the day of the sunset covenant.

Onkelos, Radak and Ramban's own view read 'three of each' / 'threefold' (Ramban notes a three-year-old cannot be called an 'eglah'). The Hebrew is ambiguous, and I render literally 'threefold' in the literal layer and discuss both options in the commentary.

Айит — собирательное единственное «хищная птица»; Синодальный перевод ставит множественное «хищные птицы», в литеральном слое оставлено единственное число, как в иврите, с «их» только там, где глагол стоит во множественном числе.
Субъект глаголов וַעֲבָדוּם וְעִנּוּ в Синодальном переводе («поработят их») понят как неопределённо-личный — те, у кого они будут жить; комментарий сохраняет открытость, о которой говорит Радак.

agent_notes: Слово «мера» в Синодальном переводе («мера беззаконий») — вставка переводчиков; в еврейском образ меры лишь подразумевается (его связывают с Раши). В буквальном слое: «не полно беззаконие Аморрея».

תַּנּוּר עָשָׁן: Синодальный перевод смягчает его до «дым как бы из печи»; в буквальном слое оставлено «дымящаяся жаровня-печь» (fire-pot), в драматическом «дымящаяся печь», как в уже принятом названии artifact.smoking_furnace.
כָּרַת בְּרִית передано буквально «вырезал завет» в буквальном слое; в драматическом слое «заключил завет» с пометкой в комментарии, так как русская Библия говорит «заключил».
По замечанию рецензента в комментарии стоит «ни кенезеи, ни кедмонеи («восточные»)», как в уже принятом имени group.kadmonites (Кедмонеи). Латинские «КJV» в прежнем тексте исправлены на «KJV».

agent_notes: Игра созвучий мешек / Дамместк (с шин и с син) в русском не передаётся; в литеральном слое оставлены транслитерации «Мешек» и «Даммесек», смысл «домочадец, распорядитель» вынесен в примечание. Синодальный перевод делает из тёмной фразы «распорядитель в доме моём».

agent_notes: В Синодальном тексте стоит [Евеев] в скобках, которого нет в еврейском; в переводе его нет, имена следуют масоретскому тексту. Перечень из десяти народов: Кенеи, Кенезеи, Кедмонеи, Хеттеи, Ферезеи, Рефаимы, Аморреи, Хананеи, Гергесеи, Иевусеи — формы Синодального перевода, как в уже принятых названиях.

[event:evt.gen_15.animals_prepared] The command (15:9) and its execution (15:10-11) are merged because the text marks no gap. The duration of 3 hours is an estimate of the work of cutting the animals and guarding them against birds until sunset. It is not given by the text.

[event:evt.gen_15.deep_sleep_at_sunset] Start snaps to the first EREV (sunset) after the animals event ends. The vision's clock time (13:28 on the linked date) comes only from the chain of offsets from Gen 14 and is not a datum of the text. I kept the animals event short enough to end before that day's sunset; otherwise the sleep would fall on the next evening.

[event:evt.gen_15.future_revealed] Prophecy of 400 years (15:13) and the fourth generation (15:16). Ex 12:40 counts 430 years and Gen 15 counts 400. I leave their fulfilment to the chapters of Exodus. No FULFILLS_PROPHECY link is possible within this chapter. The word in 15:15 (Abram dies in peace in a good old age) will be fulfilled at Gen 25:7-10, and 15:4 (the heir from his own body) at Gen 21:1-3.

[causal:caus.gen_14.abram_refuses_spoils.vision_fear_not] Inferred link. The text says only 'after these things', but 'I am a shield to you, your reward is great' answers Abram's refusal of the spoils and the fear of reprisal. Confidence 0.6.
[entity:group.hittites] Registry tags 15:20 'the Hittite' with person.heth (son of Canaan). The text names a people, so I used the existing group.hittites and did not use Heth's tipnr_id.
[entity:group.canaanites] Registry tags 15:21 'the Canaanite' with loc.canaan; the text names a people, so I used the existing group.canaanites.

[entity:loc.egypt] 15:18 'river of Egypt' (nahar Mitsrayim) is a boundary marker, mentioned with the existing loc.egypt as the nearest entity; its exact identity (Nile or Wadi el-Arish) is disputed and no separate entity is created.

[entity:person.eliezer.gen_15_2] Registry proposes person.eliezer.gen_15_2. The Hebrew phrase 'ben-meshek beti hu Dammesek Eliezer' is notoriously obscure; I read Eliezer as the steward of Abram's house who is Abram's presumptive heir (v. 3 'one born in my house').

[event_links:evt.gen_15.vision_fear_not] The chapter never states where the vision takes place. Abram dwells at Mamre since 13.18 (comp.abraham.dwelling.4) and Gen 14 ends with his return from the pursuit, so I carry loc.mamre through the whole chapter as an inference. 15:5 'brought him outside' implies a tent or dwelling.

[event_links:evt.gen_15.vision_fear_not] 15:1 'in the vision' (bamachazeh) and 15:12-16 'deep sleep' (tardemah) are treated as a revelatory state, so both are instances of sys.prophetic_vision, a system defined here.

[system:sys.covenant_cutting] Defined here rather than reused: sys.covenant_alliance (GEN.14) is a human treaty and sys.covenant_promise (GEN.6) is a bare promise. The 'cutting' ritual (karat berit with halved animals) is attested at Jer 34:18-19 and in Near Eastern treaty texts.

[system:sys.faith_reckoned_righteous] Defined here for 15:6. The subject of 'he reckoned it' is ambiguous in Hebrew; I take it as the LORD crediting Abram (the traditional reading), though some read Abram crediting the LORD.

[instance:inst.gen_15.furnace_passes] Typed as a theophany: furnace and torch are widely read as signs of the LORD's presence passing alone between the pieces. The text does not name the LORD as the one passing; this is an interpretation.

[instance:inst.gen_15.covenant_pieces] The animals preparation (15:9-11) and the passage of the furnace (15:17) are one ritual spread over two events; I recorded sys.covenant_cutting at the preparation and the theophany at the passage rather than duplicating.
[entity:group.oppressing_nation] Unnamed nation of 15:13-14 (later read as Egypt). Kept as an unnamed group, not identified with loc.egypt or group.egyptians, because the text does not name it.

[entity:loc.egypt] 15:18 'river of Egypt' (nahar Mitsrayim) is a boundary marker, mentioned with the existing loc.egypt as the nearest entity; its exact identity (Nile or Wadi el-Arish) is disputed and no separate entity is created.
